author: Shreyas Doshi, interviewed by Lenny Rachitsky
basis: Repeated professional facilitation account and detailed procedure
reported_outcomes: Reports surfacing overlooked risks and teams later reusing a shared vocabulary; avoided failures remain counterfactual.
proposed_outcomes: Expose threats early and convert concerns into mitigation or stopping actions.
limits: Benefits are practitioner reports, not a controlled comparison.
A vote for a frightening threat does not estimate its probability.
An action plan and follow-through matter; a list of risks alone is insufficient.
review_note: Retain the private-input and action-plan routine; credit the source’s attribution to Gary Klein for the premortem idea and Duke for explicit signal/action commitments.
coverage: Close-read complete relevant transcript exchanges at listed timestamps and surrounding context; not full 424-line transcript; audio/video not reviewed.
